name: bevy
description_en: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust
readme_excerpt: What is Bevy? Bevy is a refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust. It is free and open-source forever! WARNING Bevy is still in the early stages of development. Important features are missing. Documentation is sparse. A new version of Bevy containing breaking changes to the API is released approximately once every 3 months.
